subject.title: fix(plugins): prevent npm 12 metadata failures from disabling healthy plugins

question: Should this PR or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107063 become the single canonical implementation for the npm metadata state-preservation boundary?
rationale: Both branches are technically credible and proof-positive, but only this PR also normalizes the sibling update-check parser; selecting and landing one branch is an ownership decision that automation cannot safely make.

options.title: Land this broader fix
options.body: Refresh and land this PR because it covers the shared lifecycle fix plus the narrowly related singleton-array update-check parser.

options.title: Land the competing branch
options.body: Land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107063 and separately preserve or track this PR's update-check parser normalization.

options.title: Pause both branches
options.body: Pause both PRs if the owner does not accept preserving healthy plugin state for every non-E404 pre-install metadata failure.

recommendation.title: Land this broader fix
recommendation.body: Refresh and land this PR because it covers the shared lifecycle fix plus the narrowly related singleton-array update-check parser.

likelyOwner.reason: Their history spans both the update-check parser and the lifecycle behavior whose failure policy requires confirmation.
